title: Backend Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for an optional plugin.yml next to a backend plugin package mounted at BACKEND_PLUGINS_DIR (#402). Absent → the plugin loads exactly as before (fully backward compatible). Present → it declares a typed, validated config contract: route prefix, health/docs metadata, typed/default/required/secret env, dependency endpoints, and per-plugin Kong auth. A present-but-malformed manifest does NOT degrade to manifest-less loading — the plugin is skipped and a structured error is reported, leaving other plugins healthy.

plugin_manifest_version.description: Manifest schema version. Only 1 is defined today; a mismatched version is a hard error (skip the plugin), so consumers pin a version they were built against.

name.description: Stable plugin identifier (kebab-case). Must be unique across all mounted plugins; a duplicate name is rejected before mounting.

route_prefix.description: The URL path prefix this plugin's router mounts under (e.g. /tableau). Must be at least one non-empty path segment (bare '/' is rejected — it would match the whole backend). Must not overlap another plugin's prefix (raw-prefix containment) or shadow a built-in backend route (api, comfyui, documents, health, jobs, media, memory, plugins, research, storage, workflows). Drives per-plugin Kong auth composition.

health_path.description: Optional health endpoint the plugin exposes (e.g. /tableau/health), surfaced in the plugin inventory.

docs_url.description: Optional documentation link (URL or repo path) surfaced in the plugin inventory and generated docs.

auth.description: Per-plugin Kong auth policy for route_prefix. inherit = use the backend default (BACKEND_KONG_AUTH); open = no auth on this prefix even when the backend default is key-auth; key-auth = require an API key on this prefix even when the backend default is open/disabled.

env.description: Declared environment contract. Validated at startup and by the consumer doctor: required-but-missing → warning naming plugin + var; enum/type mismatches flagged. Secret values are masked in all state/doctor/docs/log output.

type.description: Declared type. int/bool/enum values are validated; a mismatch is flagged (non-fatal warning).

default.description: Default value documented for operators (not injected by Atlas).

required.description: If true, a missing/empty value produces a startup + doctor warning naming the plugin and var.

secret.description: If true, the value is masked in every state/UI/doctor/docs/log/exception surface.

depends_on.description: Optional list of upstream dependency names (e.g. litellm, weaviate, lightrag, n8n) surfaced for health/visibility. Documentation-only in v1; reserved as a versioned extension point for future narrow resource hooks.
